name: development
description: Developer workflow skills for agent context, PR fixups, CLI design, codebase-grounded landing copy, OSS readiness, OSS marketing, session log audits, decision records, and GitHub Actions self-hosted runners.

interface.shortDescription: Agent context, PR fixup, CLI design, codebase-grounded landing copy, OSS readiness, OSS marketing, session log audit, decision records, and self-hosted runner workflows
interface.longDescription: Development workflow skills for auditing agent context files, fixing existing GitHub PRs, designing humane command-line interfaces, writing product landing-page copy backed by shipped code, preparing GitHub repos for open source release, sharpening OSS README positioning, mining local agent session logs for papercuts in your own tools, writing and maintaining decision and plan records (ADRs), and running GitHub Actions self-hosted runners on a Linux host.
defaultPrompt: Audit this repo's AGENTS.md and propose a tighter rewrite.
Review this CLAUDE.md for stale, vague, or bloated agent instructions.
Create a concise AGENTS.md for this repo based on its actual tooling and structure.
Review this CLI against clig.dev and suggest concrete improvements.
Design commands, flags, help text, and output behavior for a new command-line tool.
Write landing-page copy for this product using only capabilities proven by its codebase.
Fact-check this product pitch against the code that actually ships and provide an evidence table.
Audit this repo for open source readiness and first-contributor friction.
Prepare README, CONTRIBUTING, issue templates, and PR templates for an OSS launch.
Run an OSS marketing pass on this README so first-time visitors understand why to try it.
Sharpen launch copy and positioning for an open source project.
Audit my agent session logs for papercuts in this project and rank the fixes.
Why do I keep working around my own tool? Check the last week of sessions.
Install a GitHub Actions self-hosted runner for this repository on this Linux host.
Add a second repository runner to this machine and verify it is listening.
Write a decision record for switching our job queue to Postgres.
Supersede record 012 with a new plan and update the registry.
Set up a docs/records directory with a registry README for this repo.
